evidence_for_integration.method_dependence_is_the_finding: the identical inventory helps AutoClust (+0.033474, p=3.6e-40) and does not help ML2DAC (-0.005757, ns); the between-method difference is significant on every factorial term
evidence_for_integration.mechanism_is_measured: ML2DAC CVI-selection accuracy falls from 0.6218 at 7 candidates to 0.1633 at 63
evidence_for_integration.inventory_raises_the_ceiling: group oracle utility rises A0 0.6921 -> A3 0.7707, improving 85.4% of datasets

evidence_against_a_standalone_metrics_pa.average_new46_metric_is_weaker: group mean utility New46 0.4584 vs Established 0.5461 vs Original 0.5620
evidence_against_a_standalone_metrics_pa.benefit_is_partly_concentrated: 4 New46 metrics reach the global top-10 by utility and 8 exceed a 2% oracle-win rate, out of 44 live
evidence_against_a_standalone_metrics_pa.existing_domain_only: these metrics were designed against this synthetic repository, so existing-domain strength cannot establish external validity
evidence_against_a_standalone_metrics_pa.modern_comparators_incomplete: CDbw / CVNN / CVDD / DCSI are absent

evidence_that_would_justify_separation: several New46 metrics individually strong on data not used to design them
